collection.description: An elder who lost a spouse years ago develops feelings for a new companion.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (elder), an elder who lost a spouse years ago, develops feelings for (companion), a new companion.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (elder) finds happiness without forgetting the past.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (elder) decides that companionship is enough for now.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A quiet remembrance helps (elder) feel at peace with both loves.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (elder) chooses more time before beginning a romance.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The relatives offer affection and encouragement.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The relatives are surprised but listen and grow comfortable.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The pair enjoy unhurried time together.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (elder) later chooses to share the news with friends.
